steps.title: Body: sketch the base
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as body.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (the top).
Rectangle (Two Point): from the origin to the far corner.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): 220 long, 130 wide, centred on the X axis. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Body: extrude the base and round the corners
actions: Extrude the rectangle 12 mm upwards. Click OK.
Fillet: radius 6 mm on the four vertical corner edges. Click OK.

steps.title: Body: the two rails
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the top face of the base.
Draw three rectangles: the fixed jaw footprint 35 x 100 at the left end, and two rails 170 x 15 running from it, 35 to 50 either side of the centre line.
Finish Sketch. Extrude all three profiles 30 mm upwards (Join).
steps.note: The gap between the rails (70 mm) is the slideway the moving jaw runs in.

steps.title: Body: the fixed jaw
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the top face of the fixed jaw footprint. Project Geometry (P) its outline. Finish Sketch.
Extrude 38 mm upwards (Join), so the jaw top is 80 mm above the bottom of the base.

steps.title: Body: bench bolt holes
actions: Click Hole. Placement: From Sketch, with four points on the base flange, 50 and 170 from the left end and 57.5 either side of the centre line.
Simple Hole, diameter 13 mm (clearance for M12 T-bolts), Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Body: tapped holes for the end block
actions: Click Hole and pick the end face of a rail. Place the centre 7.5 from the outside edge and 15 above the base.
Tapped Hole, Thread Type ISO Metric profile, Size 8, Designation M8x1.25. Termination Distance 25 mm.
Repeat on the other rail (or use Mirror). Click OK.

steps.title: Body: tapped holes for the jaw plate
actions: Click Hole and pick the inside face of the fixed jaw.
Two centres 30 mm either side of the centre line, 15 mm below the top.
Tapped Hole, M6x1, Distance 14 mm. Click OK. Save body.ipt.
steps.note: Inventor draws a tapped hole at its tapping size and shows the thread as a cosmetic texture.

steps.title: Moving jaw: sketch the inverted T
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as moving_jaw.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the YZ Plane (the right side).
Line: draw the inverted T. The tongue is 69 wide (0.5 clearance each side of the rails) and the head 100 wide.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): tongue 69 wide and 29.5 deep, head 100 wide and 37.5 high. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Moving jaw: extrude
actions: Extrude the profile 35 mm. Click OK.

steps.title: Moving jaw: the M16 thread for the lead screw
actions: Click Hole and pick the front face. Centre on the centre line, 14 mm up from the bottom of the tongue.
Tapped Hole, M16x2, Full Depth, Through All. Click OK.
steps.note: This tapped hole is the nut. When the screw turns, the jaw slides 2 mm for every turn.

steps.title: Moving jaw: tapped holes for the jaw plate
actions: Hole on the front face: two centres 30 mm either side of the centre line, 15 mm below the top.
Tapped Hole, M6x1, Distance 14 mm. Click OK. Save moving_jaw.ipt.

steps.title: End block
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as end_block.ipt.
Sketch a 100 x 30 Rectangle on the YZ Plane and Extrude it 15 mm.
Hole on the centre line, 15 up: Simple Hole, diameter 14 mm, Through All (the bearing for the screw journal).
Hole at 42.5 either side: Counterbore, diameter 9, counterbore 14 x 8.5 deep, Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Jaw plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as jaw_plate.ipt.
Sketch a 100 x 30 Rectangle and Extrude it 8 mm.
Hole: two centres 30 either side of the middle. Countersink, diameter 6.6, countersink 12 at 90 degrees, Through All.
Save. The same part is used on both jaws.
steps.note: Real jaw plates are hardened steel and are changed when they wear.

steps.title: Lead screw: sketch the half profile
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as lead_screw.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane (the front).
Draw a centre line along X, then the half outline: thread 8 high (M16), journal 7 high (14 diameter), boss 14 high.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): thread 160 long, journal 23 long, boss 22 long; use diameter dimensions to the centre line. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Lead screw: revolve
actions: Click Revolve. Profile: the half outline. Axis: the centre line. Full 360 degrees. Click OK.

steps.title: Lead screw: cross holes
actions: Work Plane (3D Model tab > Work Features panel > Plane): tangent to the boss, parallel to the XZ Plane.
Hole from it, 12 from the boss end face: Simple Hole, diameter 10.5, Through All (for the tommy bar).
Hole through the journal, 19 mm from the shoulder, square to the screw: diameter 4, Through All (the collar pin).

steps.title: Lead screw: chamfers and thread
actions: Chamfer 1.5 mm on the thread end and 1 mm on the boss end.
Thread: pick the 16 mm cylinder. Specification: ISO Metric profile, M16x2. Full Length. Click OK. Save.

steps.title: Thrust collar, pin, tommy bar and balls
actions: thrust_collar.ipt: Circle 26 and Circle 14 on the YZ Plane, Extrude 8; vertical Hole diameter 4 through the middle.
collar_pin.ipt: Circle 4, Extrude 26, Chamfer 0.4 both ends.
tommy_bar.ipt: Circle 10, Extrude 160.
handle_ball.ipt: half circle radius 10 with a centre line, Revolve 360; Hole diameter 10, 10 deep.

steps.title: Assembly: place the body
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as machine_vice.iam.
Place body.ipt, right click and pick Place Grounded at Origin.

steps.title: Assembly: fixed jaw plate and screws
steps.command: Assemble tab > Component panel > Place from Content Center
actions: Place jaw_plate.ipt. Constrain > Mate its back face to the fixed jaw face, then Insert one countersink onto a tapped hole.
Place from Content Center: Fasteners > Bolts > Countersunk > ISO 10642, M6 x 16. Insert one in each countersink.

steps.title: Assembly: moving jaw
actions: Place moving_jaw.ipt between the rails.
Constrain > Mate: the underside of its head to the top of the rails (offset 0.5).
Constrain > Flush: the XY Plane of the jaw part with the XY Plane of the body, so the jaw sits on the centre line.
Constrain > Mate: the jaw face 76 mm from the fixed jaw face (a 60 mm opening between the plates).

steps.title: Assembly: moving jaw plate and screws
steps.command: Assemble tab > Component panel > Place from Content Center
actions: Place jaw_plate.ipt again. Mate it to the moving jaw face and Insert a countersink onto a tapped hole.
Place two more ISO 10642 M6 x 16 screws from Content Center with Insert.

steps.title: Assembly: lead screw
actions: Place lead_screw.ipt.
Constrain > Mate (axis to axis): the screw axis to the M16 hole axis in the moving jaw.
Constrain > Mate: the shoulder between the thread and the journal flush with the rail end faces.

steps.title: Assembly: end block and cap screws
steps.command: Assemble tab > Component panel > Place from Content Center
actions: Place end_block.ipt. Insert its bore onto the screw journal at the shoulder, and Mate a counterbore axis to a tapped hole axis.
Place from Content Center: Fasteners > Bolts > Socket Head > ISO 4762, M8 x 30. Insert one into each counterbore.

steps.title: Assembly: thrust collar and pin
actions: Place thrust_collar.ipt. Insert it onto the journal against the outside face of the end block.
Place collar_pin.ipt. Insert it into the pin hole of the collar, then Mate its axis to the screw cross hole.
steps.note: The shoulder inside and the collar outside trap the end block, so the screw can turn but not move along.

steps.title: Assembly: tommy bar and balls
actions: Place tommy_bar.ipt. Insert it in the 10.5 mm cross hole and Mate its middle to the screw axis.
Place handle_ball.ipt twice. Insert each one onto an end of the bar. Save machine_vice.iam.
steps.note: Turn the tommy bar and the jaw closes: one turn of an M16 x 2 screw moves it 2 mm.
